claims.text: The semantic tagset consists of 80 semantic tags grouped in 13 coarse-grained classes.
The semantic tags are designed to provide language-neutral semantic categories to words, overcoming limitations of traditional part-of-speech tagsets.
The semantic tagging is utilized in multi-task learning settings for various NLP tasks, including part-of-speech tagging and Natural Language Inference.
